story_log.title: Brewers sweep Dodgers 6-4 in NLCS Game 4, advance to World Series for first time since 1982
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 5, TIER 1 ELIMINATION GAME, RESOLVED]: Milwaukee beat Los Angeles 6-4 per ground truth, swept series 4-0 per ground truth. Dodgers jumped ahead 4-0 on Shohei Ohtani 3-run HR (first HR since Aug 18) per JomboyMedia/ESPN/SleeperHQ. Brewers rallied — Garrett Mitchell 2-run HR, Jake Bauers bases-loaded walk tied it 4-4 per ClutchPoints/TalkinBaseball. David Hamilton 2-run HR in 9th gave Milwaukee 6-4 lead per ClutchPoints/SportsCenter/HaterReport. Jackson Chourio final-out catch sealed pennant per ClutchPoints. First Brewers pennant since 1982 per ESPN/TalkinBaseball. First team in MLB/NBA/NHL history to sweep team in best-of-7 that swept them previous year per ESPN. Jake Bauers named NLCS MVP (.286, 1 HR, 6 RBI) per ESPN/TalkinBaseball. Dodgers had lead in all four NLCS games but won none per TalkinBaseball. Series marked end of Dodgers' six-year run per TalkinBaseball. Miguel Rojas announced retirement per TalkinBaseball.

Defending champions now 3-3 per ground truth. Ryan Fitzpatrick roasted Nix postgame: 'almost disrespectful to QB position how he's playing' per HaterReport.

story_log.title: Shohei Ohtani struggles in NLCS despite Game 4 HR — 13 AB, 3 hits, 1 HR, 6 strikeouts in sweep
story_log.development: Ohtani vs Brewers in NLCS: 13 AB, 3 hits, 1 HR (first since Aug 18), 3 RBI, 6 strikeouts per ClutchPoints. Votto/Bregman breakdown on struggling while hurt in postseason per JeffPassan.

lead_story.topic: Brewers sweep Dodgers to reach World Series
lead_story.headline: Brewers complete revenge sweep of Dodgers 6-4, reach World Series for first time in 44 years

tweets.text:
THE ULTIMATE REVENGE TOUR!

The Milwaukee Brewers are the first team in MLB/NBA/NHL history to sweep a team in a best-of-7 series that swept them in a best-of-7 the previous year 😱

SWEEP REVENGE 🧹

THE BREWERS ARE HEADING TO THE WORLD SERIES FOR THE FIRST TIME SINCE 1982!

Milwaukee knocks off the two-time defending champion Dodgers in a 4-0 sweep, avenging last year's NLCS loss.

NLCS:

2026 — Brewers sweep the Dodgers
2025 — Dodgers sweep the Brewers

lead_story.research_notes: CONTINUING [Day 5]: Reader knows series was 3-0 Brewers entering Game 4, knows this is rematch of 2025 NLCS where Dodgers swept Milwaukee. Today's new development: Milwaukee completed sweep 6-4, advanced to World Series. Lead with the comeback — down 4-0 after Ohtani's first HR since August, Brewers rallied to tie on Bauers walk, then Hamilton insurance bomb sealed it. The revenge angle IS the story: first team in MLB/NBA/NHL history to sweep the team that swept them in a best-of-7 the prior year (ESPN confirms). Cross-sport rarity — research whether ANY major North American pro team has done this before across all sports, not just the three StatMuse tracks. Pat Murphy quote gold: 'They may have bunch of Hall of Famers, but we got bunch of gamers.' Payroll contrast is meme-ready: Brewers $143.5M, Dodgers over a billion (RedditCFB, HaterReport). White Sox won more playoff games than Dodgers (JayCuda). Dodgers led in ALL FOUR games and lost all four (TalkinBaseball). Bauers NLCS MVP (.286/1 HR/6 RBI), first Brewers LCS MVP despite 1982 pennant. 16K fans at Milwaukee watch party (TalkinBaseball video). Ohtani: 13 AB, 3 H, 1 HR, 6 K in series — showed rare emotion on HR then struck out twice more. Final out: Chourio catch. 44 years = rank this drought against other MLB pennant droughts ended in last 20 years. Hamilton HR was off Edwin Díaz in 9th. Series was ultimate David vs Goliath.
